purpose: Science-side inputs to the eventual Stage-4/5 architecture decision. Does NOT choose the final architecture. final_architecture_status remains UNRESOLVED, formal_pareto remains NOT_READY.

candidates.scientific_value: Two-dataset, capacity-controlled, externally-replicated positive incremental value for HR estimation.
candidates.independent_replication_status: EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_SUPPORTIVE (GalaxyPPG, independent device/subject family from PPG-DaLiA)
candidates.consistency: Consistent direction across both datasets; magnitude differs (PPG-DaLiA +0.605 bpm vs GalaxyPPG +0.834 bpm participant-level).
candidates.heterogeneity: GalaxyPPG: 6/18 subjects favor no-IMU; PPG-DaLiA: 5/5 seeds favor IMU (lower seed-level heterogeneity, no biological-subject heterogeneity reported at that granularity in this artifact).
candidates.negative_evidence: None beyond the disclosed participant heterogeneity in GalaxyPPG.
candidates.weakest_supported_endpoint: No evidence yet for other IMU-adjacent targets (e.g. activity classification, sleep/wake from wrist IMU).
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: IMU co-locates with PPG in the same wearable module - Integration Owner should compare near-zero marginal burden against the two-dataset positive evidence.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: None identified that would materially change this candidate's standing.

candidates.scientific_value: Genuine, control-verified same-dataset incremental value for sleep staging.
candidates.independent_replication_status: PENDING_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION (HMC full-cohort training not complete; bounded n=7 HMC diagnostic is inconclusive, not a negative replication)
candidates.consistency: Consistent within Sleep-EDF (A/B and A/B/C both show ~4/5 seeds favor B); the bounded HMC diagnostic disagrees but is statistically underpowered.
candidates.heterogeneity: Sleep-EDF: consistent (4/5 seeds, two independent comparisons). HMC bounded: only 2/5 seeds favor B, but n=1 test recording.
candidates.negative_evidence: HMC bounded n=7 diagnostic shows B_minus_A=-0.031 (did not reproduce at this bounded scale).
candidates.evidence_maturity: MEDIUM (strong same-dataset signal with valid control, external validity open)
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: EOG may share EEG's amplifier/reference/electrode infrastructure - Integration Owner should evaluate whether this reduces marginal burden versus treating EOG as a fully independent module.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: HMC full-cohort training (151 recordings) could materially raise or lower confidence in EOG's independent, externally-replicated value.

candidates.scientific_value: No demonstrated incremental value for the tested LBNP-stage target; real but heterogeneous negative-leaning evidence.
candidates.independent_replication_status: N/A (single dataset, new experiment - no second dataset attempted)
candidates.consistency: Both A_minus_B and C_minus_B point negative on aggregate, but both are substantially influenced by one subject (9).
candidates.heterogeneity: HIGH - A_minus_B sign-reverses and C_minus_B shrinks substantially excluding subject 9.
candidates.weakest_supported_endpoint: LBNP-stage estimation via thoracic EIS specifically - the only endpoint tested, and it is the one shown negative-leaning.
candidates.evidence_maturity: MEDIUM (real n=12 experiment with protocol-compliance fixes applied, but high subject-sensitivity)
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: Requires a dedicated EIS acquisition module distinct from PPG/ECG - Integration Owner should weigh this real added burden against the current lack of demonstrated benefit for this target.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: A larger cohort, a different target (e.g. a different physiological stress marker), or a different site (abdominal/arm) could plausibly change the picture - none of these are currently planned Stage-3 work.
candidates.decision_sensitivity_to_pending_science: LOW (no specific pending Stage-3 experiment would resolve this; would require new experimental design, out of current scope)

candidates.scientific_value: No demonstrated stable aggregate incremental value; heterogeneous, single-outlier-dominated.
candidates.consistency: Aggregate mean disfavors addition, but a majority of subjects (7/10) individually favor it - a real, disclosed tension.
candidates.heterogeneity: HIGH - single-outlier-dominated per the governing artifact's own disclosure.
candidates.strongest_supported_endpoint: None clearly positively supported at the aggregate level.
candidates.weakest_supported_endpoint: Aggregate-level body-mass-change estimation given the single-outlier sensitivity.
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: Requires bilateral leg electrode placement - real added contact-region burden.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: A larger or outlier-robust-redesigned cohort could resolve the aggregate/per-subject tension - not currently planned.
candidates.decision_sensitivity_to_pending_science: LOW (no specific pending Stage-3 experiment addresses this)

candidates.scientific_value: No demonstrated incremental value; aggregate negative, fragile to subject exclusion.
candidates.consistency: Consistently worse on aggregate (B_minus_A=+1.462 MAE), but per-seed deltas vary widely (0.07-2.11).
candidates.heterogeneity: HIGH - n=4 test subjects, sign-sensitive to exclusion per prior sprints.
candidates.weakest_supported_endpoint: PTT-based estimation via a second PPG site - the only endpoint tested.
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: Requires an additional PPG measurement site/module - real added burden with no demonstrated benefit per current evidence.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: A larger held-out test set could stabilize the direction - not currently planned.
candidates.decision_sensitivity_to_pending_science: LOW (no specific pending Stage-3 experiment addresses this)

candidates.scientific_value: Not established at n=3 - genuinely open question.
candidates.consistency: N/A - inconclusive by design at n=3.
candidates.weakest_supported_endpoint: N/A - no endpoint is currently supported at this sample size.
candidates.additional_engineering_burden_to_compare: Sparse EEG (4-channel) vs full montage is itself a burden trade-off within the EEG module - not yet informed by adequate evidence either way.
candidates.pending_science_that_could_change_decisi: The full ~65-subject ds003838 cohort (quantified: ~93GB/~9.4h additional download) could materially inform sparse-vs-full EEG channel-count architecture confidence.
